# The formula in [S1] implies: |det(J)|^(1/3)

The evidence explicitly states that the isotropic scale in contracted space is computed by taking the geometric mean of the eigenvalues of the Jacobian, which is equivalent to the d-th root of the determinant of the absolute value of the Jacobian. It further specifies that for 3D coordinates, d=3. Therefore, the formula implies |det(J)|^(1/3).
